title: Complete decrement round
statement: For every output word, input word $x$, valid input-head position $p$, and binary word $u$, the number of steps $2\beta+2$, where $\beta$ is the borrow position of $u$, is at most $2|u|+2$. Starting from the specified borrow-phase configuration with head at work-tape cell zero, counter $u$, and no change to the output, the countdown machine reaches after exactly $2\beta+2$ steps the configuration with head at cell zero, counter equal to the fixed-width decrement of $u$, and the corresponding success flag.
replaced: For every counter word $u$: a full borrow-and-rewind round of the countdown emitter from cell zero costs $2\beta + 2 \le 2|u| + 2$ steps, where $\beta$ is the borrow position of $u$, and ends at cell zero in the round-return state carrying the success flag, with the counter replaced by its fixed-width decrement and no output emitted.
